english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an aspect, feature, or respect of something.
This is the all-purpose choice for one aspect or side of a matter.
Use 方面 as the all-purpose noun for an aspect or an 'in this regard' reference.
Use 方面 when respect means a particular aspect or respect in which something differs.
Use 方面 when phase means one aspect or angle of a problem or subject.
Use this for one aspect or feature of a matter, person, or thing, as in considering its positive side.

examples.english: Battery life is one aspect where this phone performs quite well.
